root_text.title: අසිලක්ඛණ ජාතකය
root_text.author: A.P. de Zoysa
root_text.text:
• ඛුද්දකනිකාය
  • ජාතක
  • (පඨමො භාගො)
  • 1. එකක නිපාතය
  • 13. කුසනාළි වර්ගය

126. අසිලක්ඛණ ජාතකය

Msdiv 126“එකෙකුට එසේම යහපත් වෙයි. එකෙකුට එසේම අයහපත් වෙයි. එහෙයින් සියල්ලම යහපත් නොවෙයි. සියල්ලම අයහපත් නොවේ යයි කීයේය. (සමහරුන්ට ඉෂ්ටදායකවූ කටයුත්ත සමහරුන්ට අනිෂ්ට දායකමය, යනුයි.”

අසිලක්ඛණජාතකං ඡට්ඨං.

suttaplex.blurb: “Our diverse fates.”—This story was told by the Master while at Jetavana, about a brahmin retained by the King of Kosala because of his power of telling whether swords were lucky or not. We are told that when the king’s smiths had forged a sword, this brahmin could by merely smelling it tell whether it was a lucky one or not. And he made it a rule only to commend the work of those smiths who gave him presents, while he rejected the work of those who did not bribe him.
